index.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `uint32`, `int64`, `uint64`. A scalar tensor or a vector of dtype `dtype`. The index (or indices) to be shuffled. Must be within [0, max_index].
constraints: index must be one of int32, uint32, int64, uint64

seed.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `uint32`, `int64`, `uint64`. A tensor of dtype `Tseed` and shape [3] or [n, 3]. The random seed.
constraints: seed must be one of int32, uint32, int64, uint64, Tseed

max_index.description: A `Tensor`. Must have the same type as `index`. A scalar tensor or vector of dtype `dtype`. The upper bound(s) of the interval (inclusive).
constraints: max_index must have the same dtype as index

rounds.description: An optional `int`. Defaults to `4`. The number of rounds to use the in block cipher.

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `index`.
